limitations: Only two consistently oriented directed cycles with one length four and the other at least four; the two small exclusions use exhaustive verification; historical priority and independent mathematical assessment remain open.
scientific_integrity: A symbolic fibre bound and empty-column lifting proof are combined with complete bounded exhaustive checks for the two exceptional widths; no finite test is claimed as an all-parameter proof.
title: The sharp four-row cutoff for directed mutual visibility on toroidal grids
